messages.text: Police officials secretly detained several Hyderabad protest organisers near the central station before dawn, according to this urgent channel report.
Forwarded message says Hyderabad protest leaders were detained in secret by law-enforcement officers close to the central railway station early this morning.
Users are reporting that officers quietly arrested organisers of the Hyderabad demonstration near the main station before sunrise; no official confirmation yet.
BREAKING: Organisers behind the Hyderabad protest were allegedly taken into custody by police near Central Station before daybreak. Authorities remain silent.
A second message claims mobile internet will be shut down across Hyderabad at noon to prevent protest groups from coordinating their march.
Please share: Hyderabad mobile data is supposedly being disabled from midday so demonstrators cannot organise or communicate during the march.
Is the rumour about a citywide Hyderabad internet shutdown at noon real? Posts say it is intended to stop protest coordination and messaging.
Unverified alert circulating: mobile internet may go offline across Hyderabad from 12 PM, allegedly to disrupt communication between protest participants.
Hyderabad Police state that the central station is operating normally and deny reports of a coordinated overnight detention operation.
Update to the Hyderabad protest thread: police have denied the secret detention story, while several original posters have not supplied evidence.
